## Learn the inch system deliberately

Work with inch fractions, decimal inches, millimetres, and conversions. Automotive work often requires moving comfortably between systems.

## Use real measuring tools

Measure thickness, diameter, centre-to-centre distance, fasteners, badges, bearings, hose, and other real objects with rulers and calipers.

## Model from measurements

Use Onshape to turn measurements and constraints into a manufacturable part such as a personal marque badge.
